The Property is proud to present this stylish urban living in this beautifully designed 1-bedroom apartment located in the heart of Jumeirah Village Circle (JVC) at Stonehenge Residences. Spanning 743 sq. ft., this spacious unit features contemporary interiors, high-quality finishes, and a bright open-plan layout that seamlessly combines comfort and functionality.

Property Features:
- Unfurnished with Balcony
- 1 Bedroom Apartment
- 2 Bathrooms
- Built in Wardrobes
- Open Kitchen
- Large Balcony

Facilities and Amenities:

- Assigned Parking Spot
- 24 hour Security
- Elegant Lobby Waiting Area
- Guest Parking Available
- Fully Equipped Gym
- Swimming Pool & Gym
- Walking distance to Supermarkets, Restaurants, Pharmacies, and etc
- Close to Shopping Mall & Public Park
